Interviewer: Alright I get the pain point. But I was just wondering how how often do you use Linkedin on a daily basis?

Stakeholder: Okay. So like. Right now, I use Linkedin for like 2, 3 HAA day, like [I mostly used it in the morning, like, after I wake up, I'll just check to some post] or some job recommendation. Yeah.

Interviewer: Alright, I believe. You have had an amazing experience doing your job hunt on Linkedin, and I wish you very well. Thank you for sharing your experience with us. Have a good day.

Stakeholder: Thank you, you too.
goal: Check posts in the morning after waking up
